reason:
High - hooks/protocol.mjs:37-45 and hooks/codercrew-turn-complete.mjs:89-92: Synthetic-origin classification depends only on user-controlled prompt text. A real UserPromptSubmit beginning with <task-notification> is suppressed. With an active saved command, its unrelated prompt_id is added to continuations and its Stop is emitted as completion of the original command, retaining the original prompt/sourceTurnId and possibly an accepting outcome. With no active slot, a legitimate prefixed Send loses all lifecycle pairing. Reproduced with a manual XML-paste prompt and a different native prompt_id: its clear Stop completed the original command. Require trustworthy notification provenance and a verified relation to the active turn; do not exempt real prompts or alias completion solely by a text prefix. Add real-prompt and unrelated-notification regressions.

Medium - web/src/server/commit-handoff.ts:174-180: lastPublishedBy treats any appended historical entry naming the recipient as a publication by that recipient at the containing commit. Merging a side branch with a Claude entry advances the inferred baseline to the merge even when Claude never saw the main branch changes and the entry.parent does not match that merge first parent. reason: [Medium] Clear preview loading state when canceling an automatic baseline preview (web/src/components/Implementation.tsx:66-69, with previewBase finally at line 43).
